info.title: Tronicare Core compatibility API
info.description: PostgreSQL-backed REST compatibility API. Core API, Core Ingest, Core Worker, and Core Outbox run separately. Business requests require the active authority epoch and Users-owned authorization. All production authorizers perform bounded caller-token Users /v1/usersadmin/context reads of current SQL identity, role, groups, requested rights and persisted one-time-password state. With Redis configured, the cached actor and requested cached right must additionally agree; without Redis, authorization remains read-only and no legacy cache or probe fallback is used. Stale policy fails closed and one-time-password sessions cannot mutate. Exact Assets /v1/assets/scope grants scope reads; empty scope never means global access. The configured internal credential retains its explicit service authority. In migration-readonly-v1, POST/PUT/DELETE return 403 and readiness expects LEGACY_ONLY; authoritative-v1 expects POSTGRESQL_ONLY. Runtime docs/OpenAPI routes are disabled. No trailing-slash redirects. Optional configured CORS handles preflight requests.

servers.description: Origin of this separately deployed process.

get.description: Unknown or duplicate query keys are rejected for collection reads. Lists are ordered by ID and limited to 10,000 rows. All production profiles check current caller-token SQL actor, role, groups and entity rights through /v1/usersadmin/context; the Redis profile additionally validates its cached actor and right. Stale policy fails closed; profiles without Redis cannot authorize mutations.

parameters.name: IdSession
parameters.description: Optional session identity; if supplied, exactly one bounded visible-ASCII value.

parameters.name: idasset
parameters.description: Exact-match collection filter.

parameters.name: idhub
parameters.description: Exact-match collection filter.

403.description: Insufficient current method right, stale actor policy, ownership/reference outside scope, one-time-password mutation, or mutation in a read-only authorization/serving profile.

404.description: Resource is absent or outside caller scope.

422.description: Invalid ID, query, JSON object, field alias, value, or request size.

503.description: Authority inactive, dependency unavailable, or result cannot be safely completed.

post.description: Method authorization and active authority epoch are required. All production profiles check current caller-token SQL actor, role, groups and entity rights through /v1/usersadmin/context; the Redis profile additionally validates its cached actor and right. Stale policy fails closed; profiles without Redis cannot authorize mutations. Persisted one-time-password sessions are forbidden from entity mutations. Mutations carry the verified decision scope into the authority transaction; absent actor scope fails closed. Ordinary hubs, devices and sensors require a granted positive asset and the current actor organization; device/hub and sensor/device/hub parents must exist and match the effective asset. PUT checks both the persisted owner and merged fields before mutation audit. Parent and target rows are locked for those checks. Platform or configured internal service scope is explicit, not inferred from empty grants. Type catalogs retain their current entity method rights.
